svg.text: Box numbers are backpack pads (lay out by these); side notes: E22 pin | mainboard U1 pin · P4 GPIO.
Mirror rule: odd pad n mates with U1-(n+1), even pad n with U1-(n−1).
· Pads 29/30 (red frames) are the easiest to swap: pad 29 = RXEN (mainboard U1-30, GPIO29), pad 30 = GND (U1-29).
· E22 TXEN (pin 7) and DIO2 (pin 8) are tied together on the backpack and not brought to the header.
· Each multiplexed line has a 0402 series resistor; NSS and NRST 100 kΩ pull-up, RXEN 100 kΩ pull-down.
· The ID-card I2C and ESP_INT pull-ups are on the mainboard; the backpack fits none.
· The table in 3.1 is authoritative; multiplexed-line use depends on form_id. This figure shows the LoRa form.
